synopsis.native: Trois amis gays, trentenaires névrosés, parisiens agités, perdus dans les montagnes autrichiennes. Entre sommets vertigineux et gouffres abyssaux, il est peut-être temps de faire le point sur leurs vies, leurs amours et leur amitié…
synopsis.english: Three gay, excitable Parisian friends, all of them neurotic and in their thirties, get lost in the Austrian mountains. Between summits that make their heads spin and crevasses that make their hearts leap into their mouths, it is perhaps time to take stock of their lives, loves, and friendship.
